description: FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE The Fort Aguada Lighthouse, perched atop the Fort Aguada complex in Goa, is a significant historical landmark that has guided ships along the Arabian Sea for over a century. Built in 1864, this lighthouse was an essential tool for maritime navigation, helping vessels safely navigate the rocky coastlines of Goa and avoid potential hazards. FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE HISTORY The lighthouse was constructed during the British colonial period and stands as a testament to Goa’s rich maritime history. It is built from sturdy laterite stone, characteristic of many structures in Goa, and features a classic design with a tall, cylindrical tower. The lighthouse's white and red stripes make it easily identifiable and add to its historic charm. FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE TIMINGS Open: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM daily. Climbing Access: Specific hours for climbing may vary, so checking in advance is recommended. FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE ENTRY FEE Entry Fee: There is no separate entry fee for the lighthouse itself; visitors can explore the Fort Aguada area where the lighthouse is located. FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE NEARBY ATTRACTIONS FORT AGUADA Explore the historic fort itself, which includes remnants of Portuguese military architecture and offers excellent views of the sea. SINQUERIM BEACH Located at the base of the fort, this beach is ideal for a relaxing day by the sea, with options for swimming and beach activities. CALANGUTE BEACH Just a short drive away, this vibrant beach is one of Goa’s most popular destinations, known for its lively atmosphere and water sports. FORT AGUADA LIGHTHOUSE HOW TO REACH BY CAR/TAXI Fort Aguada Lighthouse is easily accessible by car or taxi from major areas in Goa, including Panaji and Calangute. It is about 13 km from Panaji and 4 km from Calangute Beach. BY PUBLIC TRANSPORT Local buses and autorickshaws can take you to Fort Aguada from nearby towns and beaches. The lighthouse is a well-known landmark, so transportation options are readily available.

headers.content: Fort Aguada Lighthouse is easily accessible by car or taxi from major areas in Goa, including Panaji and Calangute. It is about 13 km from Panaji and 4 km from Calangute Beach.
Local buses and autorickshaws can take you to Fort Aguada from nearby towns and beaches. The lighthouse is a well-known landmark, so transportation options are readily available.

Respect the rules of the lighthouse and fort area, including restrictions on climbing and photography.

What are the visiting hours for Fort Aguada Lighthouse?

The lighthouse is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM daily.

Is there an entry fee to visit the lighthouse?

There is no separate entry fee for the lighthouse; it is part of the Fort Aguada complex.

Can I climb the lighthouse?

Climbing access may be restricted, so it's best to check in advance for specific hours and guidelines.

How do I get to Fort Aguada Lighthouse?

You can reach the lighthouse by car, taxi, or local public transport from nearby towns and beaches.

What should I wear when visiting the lighthouse?

Wear comfortable shoes and dress appropriately for walking and exploring.
